content.text: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds IBM anywhere in the Agreement, and the contract expressly contemplates IBM moving volume elsewhere.

input.quote: Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, MSL agrees to produce and sell, and IBM agrees to purchase Products. This Agreement does not authorize MSL to produce or deliver any Product.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity, sole-source or requirements obligation on IBM. The purchase clause (§ 6.0, p0720) is order-driven and expressly conditioned on Purchase Orders ("This Agreement does not authorize MSL to produce or deliver any Product"), with IBM free to cancel any and all Purchase Orders at any time (§ 6.1, p0722). The Scope of Work (§ 3.0, p0102) covers only "selected" manufacturing and Services. The only "exclusive" references are unrelated (entire-agreement wording in p1500, exclusive remedy in p1574, and secure media storage in p1341). Section 9.0(e) (p0186) affirmatively contemplates "reductions of Products requirements due to migration to a competitive supplier", confirming our freedom to source elsewhere; it only allocates severance cost, which is not a restrictive covenant. This meets the preferred position, so no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
